title: Window Returns & Opening Finishes
short_answer: Job Start carries Window type and Window returns for a reason. Wrong wrap vs butt is a classic residential callback — and a free rebuild if we guessed.
summary: Job Start carries Window type and Window returns for a reason. Wrong wrap vs butt is a classic residential callback — and a free rebuild if we guessed.
plain_words: Before you hang returns, open the Job Start packet. Window type (drywall, wood, or both) and the Window returns note tell the crew what we sold. If the packet is blank and the drawings are vague, that is a question for the lead/office — not a field invention on the first window.
when_to_use: Before the first window return or opening wrap
When Job Start window type or returns fields are blank or unclear
Mixed openings on the same job (drywall vs wood returns)
prerequisites: Job Start packet open — Window type + Window returns text
Door/window schedule or approved detail when packet references it

tools.name: Tape measure for RO and return depth

steps.body: Read Job Start: Window type + Window returns text. Match the packet, not the last subdivision's habit.
Confirm ownership — drywall return vs wood return vs trim by others. Mixed openings are common; do not assume every window is the same.
Check the RO and the window actually in the opening before cutting returns. Wrong RO is a phone call; wrong return after hang is rework.
Depth / wrap: follow the detail or the packet note. If neither exists, stop and ask — do not invent a wrap depth to look finished.
Bead and corners at returns crack when framing or board is forced. Square the opening; mud will not fix a twisted return.
Extra wrap or upgrade beyond what we sold is a change order path — Spotting a Change Order — not a favor to the builder.

warnings.title: Why this page exists
warnings.body: Window returns and garage finish are classic GVC rework causes — that is why they live on the Job Start form. The packet is the stand-behind source for what the crew builds at openings; habit is not.

quality_checks.prompt: Window type and returns read from Job Start before first return
Drywall vs wood vs trim-by-others confirmed per opening
RO and installed window verified before cutting returns
